usedFor: Shopify holds store checkouts, and each “Abandoned Checkout” can add a lead in Instantly.

bestTemplate.name: “Abandoned Checkout” in Shopify, then “Create Lead” in Instantly
bestTemplate.why: Shoppers who left at checkout, with email or phone entered, become leads in a list or campaign.

watchOut: “Abandoned Checkout” in Shopify is polling, so leads arrive after a scheduled check.
